ending.line: This world with too few happy endings
stanza: The whole world's broke and it ain't worth fixing
It's time to start all over, make a new beginning
There's too much pain, too much suffering
Let's resolve to start all over, make a new beginning
Now don't get me wrong. I love life and living
But when you wake up and look around at everything
You see we need to change it now
This world with too few happy endings
We can resolve to start all over
